verdict.rationale: Codex's core value proposition is delegating coding tasks to a built-in AI agent — docs explicitly describe 'Delegate a longer task and return when it is ready,' running tasks in cloud/CLI/IDE, and even sub-delegating to specialized agents within a session. Community posts corroborate real-world usage of this delegation flow (e.g., long-running agentic tasks completing autonomously), though sentiment on reliability is mixed. Missing for 10: independent quality benchmarks confirming consistent delegation outcomes and less mixed community sentiment on task success rate.
